name: PT Jaya Real Property, Tbk.
summary: PT Jaya Real Property, Tbk., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a property development, management, and investment company in Indonesia. The company operates through the Sale of Land and Buildings, and Rental and Other Services segments. The Sale of Land and Buildings segment engages in the real estate and urban development activities; and release/purchase, processing, maturation, and development of facilities and infrastructure, as well as entertainment segment activities, such as ice rink, water park, sports club, driving range, and oceanarium.
